Title: LSJ QMadness Network and Tirst Tradition

Messages.Author: Emile Bosman
Messages.Body:
I think I no the answer to this one but i still wanted to make sure

If I play a first tradition and have a madness network in play can I
take actions via the madness network if the player didn't pay the 3
pool for the first tradition so in efect forfeiting they're turn?

I think the answer is no but I'm still doubtfull.

Emile

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Emile Bosman wrote:
> If I play a first tradition and have a madness network in play can I

> take actions via the madness network if the player didn't pay the [2]

> pool for the first tradition so in efect forfeiting they're turn?

No. If they don't have a turn, they don't have a minion phase in which
your Malks can act.

Madness Network is great, esp when combined with Homonculus or Carrion
Coffin. CC is probably better if you're playing 1st Trad since you'll get to
untap ( at the end of your turn ) even if no-one decides to have a turn. As
long as someone pays to have a turn, you'll get to have a turn without
paying yourself. Even w/ basic Protean the combo works well. Don't forget
Flesh of Marble and Adaptability if you get into a fight, it's quite a nice
combo.
